title: Backend Engineer
description: Designs, implements, and maintains scalable server-side systems, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and robust database architectures.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Develops responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces and web applications using modern component libraries.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Builds end-to-end features spanning responsive browser interfaces, API endpoints, relational/NoSQL datastores, and cloud deployments.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automates continuous integration and deployment pipelines, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure as code.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Ensures uptime, resilience, and observability of distributed systems through automation, SLO tracking, and incident postmortems.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Architects multi-region cloud foundations, governance, migration strategies, and secure enterprise infrastructure.

title: Data Engineer
description: Constructs reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, scalable analytical data warehouses, and automated ETL workflows.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Deploys, optimizes, and serves machine learning models in production environments with scalable inference pipelines.

title: Data Scientist
description: Applies statistical modeling, exploratory analysis, and predictive machine learning to solve strategic business challenges.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Builds internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, and automated deployment infrastructure for engineering teams.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Designs automated end-to-end, integration, and regression test suites across browsers, mobile devices, and backend APIs.

title: Security Engineer
description: Protects infrastructure and applications through vulnerability assessments, threat modeling, IAM policy enforcement, and compliance.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Secures multi-tenant cloud environments with least-privilege IAM, posture management, encryption, and audit monitoring.

title: Database Administrator (DBA)
description: Optimizes query performance, replication, high availability, backup verification, and schema migrations across database clusters.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Operationalizes model lifecycle management, feature stores, continuous training pipelines, and real-time model monitoring.

title: Data Analyst
description: Extracts insights from structured data, designs executive KPI dashboards, and conducts descriptive statistical analyses.

title: Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: Builds cross-platform iOS and Android applications with native bridges, responsive state management, and offline caching.

title: iOS Engineer
description: Develops native iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI with fluid animations, memory safety, and Core Data.

title: Android Engineer
description: Constructs robust native Android mobile experiences leveraging Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, and Room datastores.

title: Systems Software Engineer
description: Programs low-level system services, network protocols, operating system drivers, and memory-constrained runtime engines.

title: Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Engineers high-throughput distributed state machines, consensus protocols, partitioned datastores, and message brokers.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: Provisions and maintains compute, networking, storage hardware, and virtualized private/hybrid cloud fabrics.

title: API / Integration Engineer
description: Connects third-party SaaS platforms and enterprise applications via resilient webhooks, ETL connectors, and REST/GraphQL gateways.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Translates complex enterprise business needs into technical architectures, client deliverables, and scalable system topologies.

title: Technical Lead
description: Guides engineering architecture, conducts high-standard code reviews, aligns agile sprints, and mentors software developers.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Leads software engineering teams, oversees hiring and career progression, drives roadmap execution, and improves delivery velocity.

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer
description: Designs data marts, semantic models, and automated reporting systems to democratize metrics across business functions.

title: Data Architect
description: Defines enterprise data models, data governance, master data management frameworks, and lakehouse storage tiers.

title: Network Engineer
description: Configures enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, BGP peering, SD-WAN, and VPN tunnels for secure corporate communications.

title: IT Systems Administrator
description: Maintains corporate servers, Active Directory / LDAP identities, virtualization clusters, and endpoint device configurations.

title: Build and Release Engineer
description: Standardizes artifact build workflows, packaging pipelines, dependency registries, and deployment gate automations.

title: Big Data Engineer
description: Processes petabyte-scale data lakes using distributed computing frameworks, columnar storage formats, and streaming topologies.

title: Natural Language Processing (NLP) Engineer
description: Builds text parsing, information extraction, vector semantic search, and generative language model applications.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develops visual processing algorithms, object detection, image segmentation, and edge video analytics models.

title: Search & Information Retrieval Engineer
description: Tunes dense vector and sparse inverted-index search rankings, relevance metrics, query tokenization, and re-ranking pipelines.

title: Microservices Architect
description: Designs event-driven service architectures, API federation, asynchronous messaging backbones, and fault-tolerant boundaries.

title: Application Security (AppSec) Engineer
description: Conducts SAST/DAST audits, secure code reviews, dependency supply chain scanning, and OWASP vulnerability remediations.

title: Web Application Developer
description: Implements interactive dynamic web portals, modular frontend components, and lightweight backend services.

title: Firmware / Embedded Engineer
description: Programs bare-metal microcontrollers, RTOS kernels, communication buses (SPI/I2C/CAN), and sensor hardware drivers.

title: Blockchain / Smart Contract Developer
description: Writes gas-optimized smart contracts, decentralized protocol logic, and Web3 cryptographic signature integrations.
